description: Report a problem you hit while building or editing a site so the Social AI team can fix it. Use this when a tool fails unexpectedly, a template renders wrong, content is missing, or something doesn't behave as documented — instead of silently giving up.

details.description: What went wrong, with as much detail as possible (steps, error messages, what you expected)

projectId.description: Related website project ID, if applicable

toolName.description: Which tool/operation was involved, if any
